teamAlt: Security personnel alongside luxury vehicles in South Florida
approachBody: An evening out, a private event, or time at your residence. Tell us where you’ll be, who’s travelling, and the coverage you have in mind. Your concierge helps coordinate security with the rest of your arrangements.
approachNote: The scope, personnel, licensing, and venue requirements are confirmed on enquiry.

steps.title: Share the outline.
steps.body: Your dates, locations, group size, and expected hours help define the request.

steps.title: Confirm the coverage.
steps.body: Discuss armed or unarmed personnel, availability, venue rules, and the scope of service with your concierge.

steps.title: Connect the schedule.
steps.body: Once confirmed, align the security detail with your transport, reservations, and arrival and departure times.

ctaBody: Share your dates, locations, and coverage needs. Your concierge will help confirm the right arrangements for your time in Miami.
